Spain.tactical_note: Spain adapts to midfield evolution; Gavi/Pedri pivot likely. Defensive transitions challenging without Busquets experience.
Spain.fantasy_note: Rodri and Pedri are fantasy anchors. Morata's minutes questionable; monitor striker rotation.

Argentina.tactical_note: Argentina shifts to post-Messi era with youthful attacking talent. Flexible 4-3-3 balances control and directness.
Argentina.fantasy_note: Álvarez and Mac Allister offer consistent attacking returns. Fernández crucial for midfield dominance.

France.tactical_note: France likely maintains 4-3-3 with Mbappé leading attack. Midfield rotation between Camavinga, Fofana, Verratti successors.
France.fantasy_note: Mbappé is standout asset. Tchouaméni offers midfield security. Griezmann/Giroud retirements may open striker opportunities for younger talent like Haller or Tielemans midfield depth.

England.tactical_note: Tuchel likely employs balanced 4-3-3 with Bellingham as box-to-box anchor. Foden provides attacking midfield threat.
England.fantasy_note: Bellingham and Foden are premium picks. Saka consistent. Kane's inclusion uncertain—monitor form.

Brazil.tactical_note: Attacking 4-3-3 with emphasis on width. Bruno Guimarães as box-to-box anchor.
Brazil.fantasy_note: Vinícius and Rodrygo offer high upside. Monitor Neymar recovery status.

Portugal.tactical_note: Portugal transitions post-Ronaldo with younger attacking talent. Neves integrates into midfield core.
Portugal.fantasy_note: Bruno Fernandes remains essential. Monitor Gonçalo Ramos and Rafael Leão fitness.

Netherlands.tactical_note: Balanced 4-3-3 with creative midfield; emphasis on possession and wide play
Netherlands.fantasy_note: Gakpo and Koopmeiners offer best fantasy value; Depay risky

Belgium.tactical_note: Belgium transitions with young core led by De Bruyne. Defensive experience crucial with aging backline.
Belgium.fantasy_note: De Bruyne highest fantasy value. Lukaku and Doku provide attacking upside if fit.

Germany.tactical_note: Germany likely plays possession-based 4-2-3-1 with creative midfield dominance. Flexibility to 4-3-3 with Musiala shifting wide.
Germany.fantasy_note: Wirtz and Musiala key for attacking returns. Kimmich and Gündoğan provide midfield stability. Monitor Kroos availability pre-tournament.

Croatia.tactical_note: Transition squad with aging core. Gvardiol and Kovačić anchor younger generation.
Croatia.fantasy_note: Modrić uncertain. Kramarić and Budimir rotation risk. Gvardiol most consistent fantasy option.

Morocco.tactical_note: Morocco likely maintains defensive solidity with wingback support. Balance between experience and emerging talent.
Morocco.fantasy_note: Amrabat and Hakimi are the most consistent fantasy options. Monitor Ziyech's form going into tournament.

players.name: Luis Suárez
players.doubt_reason: Age 39, may be retired or bench

Uruguay.tactical_note: Bielsa prefers pressing 4-3-3. Uruguay aging but Valverde-Ugarte midfield core remains strong. Rebuild ongoing in attack/defense.
Uruguay.fantasy_note: Valverde and Ugarte safest picks. Suárez participation uncertain. Monitor fullback selections pre-tournament.

Colombia.tactical_note: Colombia likely maintains attacking-minded 4-2-3-1 with Díaz and Durán providing width. James playmaking from center critical to creative flow.
Colombia.fantasy_note: Luis Díaz offers best fantasy value with consistent output. Lerma/Barrios are defensive anchors with limited ceiling.

Switzerland.tactical_note: Balanced 4-2-3-1 with creative midfield. Xhaka remains crucial pivot.
Switzerland.fantasy_note: Embolo and Ndoye offer attacking returns. Akanji reliable for defense.

Japan.tactical_note: Japan likely maintains compact 4-2-3-1 with emphasis on possession and quick transitions. Fullback support crucial.
Japan.fantasy_note: Doan and Endo are fantasy anchors. Mitoma offers upside on left flank. Forward spot volatile.

players.name: Achraf Hakimi
players.doubt_reason: May shift to RB or pursue other opportunities

Senegal.tactical_note: Senegal likely maintains possession-based approach with width from wing-backs and attacking midfielders.
Senegal.fantasy_note: Mané and I. Sarr provide upside; Gueye offers defensive floor but limited fantasy returns.

United States.tactical_note: Balanced 4-3-3 with Pulisic as creative left outlet. Adams anchors midfield. Attacking flexibility via Weah/wingers.
United States.fantasy_note: Pulisic and Adams are standouts. Monitor Reyna/Weah availability and form trajectory into summer.

Mexico.tactical_note: Mexico expected to rely on youthful attacking talent with Giménez leading the line. Defensive stability key with Álvarez anchoring midfield.
Mexico.fantasy_note: Giménez highest fantasy priority. Lozano and Vega provide creative outlet. Álvarez valuable for defensive stats.

Ecuador.tactical_note: Ecuador relies on midfield control via Caicedo. Attacking width from wingers compensates for modest striker depth.
Ecuador.fantasy_note: Caicedo is essential. Plata offers consistency. Monitor Valencia's status; likely replaced by younger talent like Páez.

Austria.tactical_note: Rangnick emphasizes pressing and midfield control. Baumgartner key to build-up.
Austria.fantasy_note: Laimer and Baumgartner offer good upside. Arnautović set-piece threat but aging.

Norway.tactical_note: Norway likely plays compact 4-2-3-1 with emphasis on counter-attacking through Sorloth pace
Norway.fantasy_note: Sorloth and Sander Berge are key attacking assets; midfield depth creates rotation risk

Sweden.tactical_note: Sweden relies on Isak's physicality with Kulusevski's creativity. Likely narrow midfield with wing support.
Sweden.fantasy_note: Isak & Kulusevski are primary creators. Forsberg offers midfield attacking upside in deeper competitions.

Egypt.tactical_note: Elneny-El-Solia pivot shields defense. Salah drifts inside; Trezeguet provides left-side width.
Egypt.fantasy_note: Salah is captain and primary playmaker. Elneny provides consistency. Mostafa Mohamed's form crucial for attacking threat.

Ivory Coast.tactical_note: Balanced midfield with attacking width. Balogun as focal point.
Ivory Coast.fantasy_note: Kessié and Adli offer midfield stability. Balogun main attacking threat.
